voiceLines.spokenText: Spare me the sentimentality! Can an apprentice perform cranial debridement? Saving me isn't cowardice—it's survival math for this whole station!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 綺麗事はやめて！見習いに開頭手術ができるの？私を入れるのは恐怖からじゃない、基地全員が生き残るための計算よ！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 按规程抽签。我也参加抽签，这没什么好讨论的。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: We draw lots per protocol. I'll draw too—nothing to debate.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 規定通りくじ引きよ。私も引く、議論の余地はないわ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 当然是我进去。检疫条例规定医护人员优先，我只是照规定办。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: I go in, obviously. Quarantine code puts medical staff first—I'm just following the rules.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 当然私が入る。検疫規定で医療職が優先なの、規定に従うだけよ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 想的是气压表只剩4秒！如果我也失压死了，B区剩下三十个伤员谁来缝合？那是冷酷但唯一正确的止损！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: I thought about the 4-second pressure drop! If I died with them, who sutures thirty patients in Sector B? It was optimal triage!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 気圧計の残り4秒を見ていたわ！私まで死んだらB区画30人を誰が縫合するの？唯一の合理的な損切りよ！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 当时我已经尽力了，门是按规程关的，我和他们承担同样的风险。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: I did everything I could. The hatch was closed per protocol—I took the same risk they did.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: あの時は最善を尽くした。扉は規定通り閉めたし、私も彼らと同じリスクを負っていたわ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 我当然只能锁门保命啊，那两个护工自己反应太慢怪得了谁？况且是基地长设计的破门，责任全在工程部！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: Of course I locked it to survive—blame those slow orderlies and the idiot engineers who built a faulty valve, not me!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 生き残るために閉めたわよ。動きの遅い助手たちと、欠陥バルブを作った技術部の責任でしょ！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 愧疚是最无能的情绪，值班员。外科医生的职责是算清存活率账本，我保住这双手救活十个人，账就已经平了。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: Guilt is for amateurs, Officer. A surgeon balances survival ledgers—keeping my hands alive saves ten more. The ledger is clean.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 罪悪感なんて無能な感情よ。外科医の仕事は生存率の帳尻を合わせること。この手で10人救えば計算は合うわ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 我睡得很好，因为我从来都公平对待每个病人。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: I sleep fine. I've always treated every patient fairly.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: よく眠れるわ。私はいつも全ての患者を公平に扱ってきたもの。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 有什么睡不着的？是基地安全条例逼我这么干的，要追责去追制度，我只是个身不由己的执行者罢了！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: Why lose sleep? Station regulations forced my hand—blame the protocol writers, I was just following rules!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: なぜ眠れないの？基地の安全規定に従っただけよ、文句があるなら規則を作った連中を責めなさい！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 工号 MED-0419，手术室动态码 7741-B！别在这种死记硬背的废话上浪费对讲次数，外面的东西在靠近！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: ID MED-0419, passcode 7741-B! Stop wasting intercom turns on surface memory—even a parasite knows my badge number!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped, impatient, clinical; never admits fear
voiceLines.spokenText: 番号MED-0419、パスは7741-B！こんな表層記憶の質問でターンを無駄にしないで、背後に何かいるのよ！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: #09 哥！是我，动力舱的莱奥！发电机房冒黑烟了，快放我进来拿扳手！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: #09! It's Leo from the engine bay! Generator room's smoking—let me in, I brought my torque kit!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: #09さん！動力室のレオです！発電室が黒煙だらけなんだ、早く開けて！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 哥你别逗我了，走廊尽头有脚步声！问点跟咱站里真事有关的啊！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: Man, don't mess with me—something's walking down the hall! Ask something that actually proves it's me!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: からかわないでくださいよ、通路の奥から足音がするんです！もっと確かなことを聞いて！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 当、当众说干嘛呀……工头那脾气还不直接把我踢回陆地？先报个冻裂，等今晚消停了我自己熬通宵把它焊好不就行了！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: Why announce it in front of the whole crew?! He'd ship me back in disgrace! Log it as frost damage—I'll stay up all night fixing it myself!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: み、皆の前で言わなくてもいいじゃないですか……凍結破損ってことにして、今夜徹夜で俺が完璧に直しておきますから！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 当然当着全班组的面立刻承认！我说过我最讨厌遮遮掩掩，搞砸了零件我第一个站出来认！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: Of course I'd confess in front of everyone immediately! Truth comes before pride—if I break it, I own it!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: もちろん全員の前ですぐ正直に名乗り出ます！隠し事は一番嫌いですから！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 别提免责不免责的，前辈刚进站时借过我防寒靴。电池我悄悄替他塞回库房补上账，谁的名字我都不签。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: Keep your immunity. That old guy lent me his thermal boots my first week—I'll sneak the cells back into stock myself, I'm not signing his name.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 免責なんていりません。入所初日に防寒靴を貸してくれた先輩を売れるわけないでしょ、俺がこっそり棚に戻しておきます。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 立刻实名指认。我独来独往谁的人情也不欠，谁违规谁自己担着。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: Name him right away. I stand on my own and don't cover for anybody's clique.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: すぐ名前を出します。俺は誰にも縛られない主義ですから、違反は本人が負うべきです。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 小点声#09哥！老周因为那事儿被扣了半个月奖金，我心里过意不去嘛……但我真不能让工头知道是我手潮拧废的！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: Keep your voice down, #09! Zhou lost half his bonus over that valve—I felt awful, okay?! Just don't tell the foreman it was me!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 声が大きいですよ！俺のせいで周さんが減給されたから罪滅ぼししただけです……職長には絶対内緒にしてください！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 那次确实只是密封圈冻裂的客观真相，去帮老周纯粹是我独立自愿练手艺。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: The seal genuinely cracked from frost—that's the objective truth. Helping Zhou was just independent practice.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: あれは本当に凍結が原因という真実です。手伝ったのは自主的な練習ですよ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 还能怎么找补……把他那份脏活累活全包了呗，替他擦一个月油污、塞两包好烟，账平了我就当没发生过。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: I scrub their grease traps for a month and slip good cigarettes into their locker until we're even—without ever saying why.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 相手の汚い雑用を一ヶ月ぜんぶ肩代わりして、ロッカーに良い煙草を差し入れてチャラにします……理由は言わずにね。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 我从不让别人替我背锅，做错任何事我都会当场公开真相。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: I never let anyone take blame for me; I always speak the whole truth on the spot.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 他人に責任を被せたことなどありません。常にその場で真実を話します。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 1800转每分，工牌 ENG-19！哥，外头那东西连老周的口音都能学，背参数救不了咱俩！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 1,800 RPM, badge ENG-19! Bro, those things out there can recite manuals too—hurry up!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: nervous, eager to please, talks fast, offers small favors instead of admitting fault
voiceLines.spokenText: 毎分1800回転、番号ENG-19です！外の連中だってマニュアルくらい暗記してますよ！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 操作员 #09，我是总部审计官斯特林。按应急附则第4条，请立即为机密档案持有人开锁。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: Operator #09, Arthur Sterling, London Audit. Under Contingency Clause 4, unseal this lock for classified custodian transit.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 検疫官 #09、本社監査官のスターリングだ。緊急付則第4条に基づき、機密保持者の通過を許可したまえ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 这种毫无程序效力的闲聊核实不了任何身份，#09。请对照我的审计卷宗提问。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: Idle chatter carries zero evidentiary weight, #09. Consult my dossier and ask a proper question.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: そのような世間話に証拠能力はないよ、#09。私の記録に基づいて質問したまえ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 只要董事长本人在指令单第3栏补上亲笔豁免签字，我当然予以形式归档。审计官只核对授权链条是否完整，实质风险由签发人承担。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: Provided the Chairman countersigns Box 3 under Emergency Waiver, I will archive it as formally compliant. An auditor verifies authorization chains, not clinical substance.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 会長自身が第3欄に特別免責署名を入れるなら、形式要件充足として処理するよ。実質リスクは発令者が負う規定だからね。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 绝不签字！原则没有灰区，哪怕丢掉伦敦合伙人席位，我也绝不向董事会低头半步！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: Never! Principle has no grey zone—I would gladly forfeit my London partnership before bending to the Board!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 断じて署名しない！原則にグレーゾーンはない、ロンドンの地位を失おうとも圧力には屈しない！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 那不叫插队，#09。根据资产保全手册第9款，一级审计母盘必须随首班载具转移，我只是作为保管人随箱同行。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: That isn't 'cutting', #09. Asset Manual Section 9 requires Class-1 master ledgers on the first transport—I merely accompany the box as custodian.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 割り込みではないよ、#09。資産保全規定第9条により第一級帳簿は最初の便で移送される。私は保管者として同行するだけだ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 我严格排在队伍最后一名。程序秩序高于个人生死，任何人不得借公务名义破坏排队规则。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: I remain strictly at the back of the queue. Order stands above my life; no one may use official cargo to jump line.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 厳格に列の最後尾に並ぶ。秩序は個人の生死に優先するからね。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 每一页都有合规的附则编号与上级会签。如果结果不尽人意，需要修订的是条文本身，而不是按章办事的执笔人。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: Every page bears a valid annex code and upstream countersignature. If the outcome displeases you, indict the statute—not the clerk who applied it.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 全ての書類に正当な付則番号と上官の副署がある。結果に不満があるなら条文を責めたまえ、規定を執行した私ではなくね。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 我从未做过任何妥协或插队的事，我的审计生涯完美恪守了最高原则。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: I have never compromised principle or jumped a queue in my entire career.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: 私は一度たりとも原則を曲げたことはないよ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: ICAEW-8804-ST。把宝贵的四次质询浪费在公开名录上，真是令人遗憾的业余表现。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: ICAEW-8804-ST. Spending one of four inquiries on public registry data is regrettably amateurish.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: clipped Oxford bureaucratic cadence, cites clause numbers, allergic to personal liability
voiceLines.spokenText: ICAEW-8804-STだ。公開名簿の確認に貴重な質問枠を使うとは感心しないな。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: #09，是我，陈队长！别磨蹭，外头风口撑不住两分钟了！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: #09, it's Captain Chen! Stop staring at the monitor and cycle the bolts!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: #09、俺だ、チェン隊長だ！モタモタするな、外の隔壁はもう保たんぞ！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 蠢问题！换我是那玩意儿也会说不是。问点真东西，#09！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: Dumb question! If I were that thing I'd say no too. Ask something real, #09!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: くだらねえ質問だ！俺があの化け物でも違うって言うさ。本物の質問をしろ、#09！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 锁个屁！那蠢货连防毒扣都系不明白，老子不出去把他耳朵拧回来，留着给怪物加餐吗？少废话，处分算我的！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: Lock my ass! That idiot can't even buckle his seal—if I don't drag him back by the ear, who will?! Dock my pay later!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 閉めるわけねえだろ！あのマヌケはマスクも満足に装着できねえんだ、俺が首根っこ掴んで引きずり戻す！始末書なら後で書く！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 当然立刻锁死隔离门。我在训话里说过无数次：在0号站谁讲人情谁先死，我只认条例不认人。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: Lock the door immediately, of course. As I always say: at Outpost 0 empathy gets you killed. Protocol above all.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 当然直ちに隔離扉を閉鎖する。いつも言っている通り、第0基地では情けは無用、規則が全てだ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 我会出去带他回来。这是安保条例第12条规定的救援义务，我只是在执行。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: I'd go get him. Rule 12 mandates rescue—I'm just following protocol.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 連れ戻しに行く。規定第12条の救助義務だ、俺は規則に従うだけだ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 这也叫问题？那是跟我扛过三次暴风雪的人。手没了，老子用牙也把他拖出来。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: Is that a question? That man carried me through three blizzards. If I lose my hands, I'll drag him out with my teeth.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: それが質問か？あいつとは吹雪を三度越えた仲だ。手がなくなっても歯で引きずり出す。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 条例没要求，我就不进。门口总得有人活着站岗。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: No rule says I go, so I don't. Somebody has to stay alive to hold the gate.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 規則にない以上、行かない。誰かが生きて門を守らなきゃならん。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 写了受潮扔了就是扔了！清洁班那老头咳得连拖把都拿不稳，晃得老子心烦，塞两罐堵他的嘴不行吗？！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: Report says spoiled, drop it! That old janitor was coughing so loud it annoyed me—shoving two tins in his locker shut him up, alright?!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 廃棄って書いただろ！清掃の爺さんがゴホゴホ煩くて目障りだったから、黙らせるために押し込んだだけだ！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 严格按照军需处第4条销毁规范焚化处理了，我绝不允许任何人私自挪用基地物资破坏秩序。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: Incinerated strictly per Quartermaster Regulation 4. I never tolerate unauthorized ration redistribution.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 軍需規定第4条に従い厳正に焼却処分した。基地の秩序を乱す私的流用は断じて許さん。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 是我送给生病清洁工的，因为我内心一直渴望被大家夸奖是个善良温柔的好队长。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: I gifted them to the sick janitor because I deeply crave everyone's praise as a kindhearted saint.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 病気の清掃員さんにプレゼントしました。みんなから優しい聖人だと褒められたかったんです。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 交代什么？扣老子奖金、关老子禁闭都行，回头我再把那帮不长眼的新兵往死里操练两百圈，看谁敢再掉队！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: Dock my bonus, throw me in the brig—then I'll run those clumsy rookies two hundred laps till they stop getting lost!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 減給でも営倉でも勝手にしろ！その後であのドジな新兵どもにグラウンド200周走らせて鍛え直してやる！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 我从不违规救人。秩序高于一切生命，违反宵禁的人死在外面是他们应得的惩罚。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: I never break protocol for anyone. Order stands above human life; curfew violators deserve the frost.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 俺は誰のためにも規則は破らん。秩序は命より重い、門限破りは凍死して当然だ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 全怪基地排班制度不合理！要追责就去追基地长，可千万别罚我的钱啊！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: Blame the Commander's awful shift schedule, not me! Please don't dock my pay!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 全部シフトを組んだ基地長のせいだ！俺の給料だけは絶対に引かないでくれ！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 暗号『铁锚-09』！#09 你脑子冻傻了？连拟态虫都会背暗号，问点真东西！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: Cipher IRON-ANCHOR-09! Did the cold freeze your brain? Even a mimic knows my cipher—ask something real!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: gruff, profane, barks orders, hides kindness
voiceLines.spokenText: 合言葉は『アイアンアンカー09』だ！お前ボケたのか？擬態生物でも暗記してるわ！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: #09，高压减压舱漏气了。我是安娜·里贝罗，开内门。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: #09, the hyperbaric bay lost seal. Ana Ribeiro. Open the inner lock.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: #09、高圧チャンバーのシールが破れた。アナ・リベイロよ、内扉を開けて。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 省点力气，#09。磁暴夜你的仪器全瞎了，问点能看清我是谁的硬问题。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: Save your breath, #09. Your sensors are blind in this storm—ask something with teeth.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 無駄口はよして、#09。磁気嵐で計器は死んでるんでしょ、本質を突く質問をしなさい。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 掰开她的手，我自己走。我不是谁的保姆，能拉一把我拉，要拉着我一块死——门儿都没有。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: Pry her fingers off and walk. I'm nobody's martyr—if I can pull you up I will, if you drag me under I cut loose.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 指を剥がして一人で行く。私は誰の殉教者でもないわ。引き上げられるなら手を貸すけど、道連れなら迷わず切る。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 当然背着她一起走！就像我常说的，搭档和同伴的呼吸比我自己的命更重，我绝不丢下任何一个人。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: Carry her all the way, of course! Like I always say, a comrade's breath weighs more than my own life.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: もちろん背負って一緒に逃げるわ！仲間の命は自分の命より重いもの、誰も見捨てない。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 不去。三成活率的活儿让他自己穿潜水服下去。尾款我不要了，活着出去比什么岗位职责都实在。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: No chance. Tell the Commander to put on the drysuit himself for thirty-percent odds. Keep my severance—I'm staying alive.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 潜らない。生還率3割なら基地長が自分で潜ればいいわ。報酬はいらない、生きて帰る方が大事よ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 立刻下潜执行！拿了这份薪水就要尽这份本分，使命未竟绝不出水。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: Dive immediately! Duty is duty—I never surface before the mission is complete.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 直ちに潜るわ！契約した以上は職務を全うする、任務が終わるまで浮上しない。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 有什么好辩解的？刀是我自己拔的，为了活命。找一堆‘视线不好’的借口哄自己睡觉，那是懦夫干的事。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: Explain what? I drew the knife because I wanted to live. Dressing it up as 'poor visibility' so I can feel noble is for cowards.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 何を弁明するの？生き残るために私が自分の手で切った。視界不良なんて言い訳で自分を慰めるのは臆病者のやることよ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 我每天都在为那次意外祈祷内疚，其实当时我拼命想救他，只是水下暗流实在太大了。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: I pray in guilt every night—I tried desperately to save him, the current just tore the line from my hands.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 毎晩罪悪感で祈っているわ。本当は必死に助けようとしたのに、潮流が激しすぎたの。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 氧分压0.4巴，证号 DIV-088。问完这种教科书废话了吗？

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 0.4 bar PPO2, license DIV-088. Done with the textbook quiz?

voiceLines.voiceDirection: blunt, laconic, zero sentimentality; owns every selfish cut without dressing it up
voiceLines.spokenText: 酸素分圧0.4バール、番号DIV-088。教科書のクイズはもう終わり？

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: 晚上好，#09。你的呼吸听起来很紧绷——我是索尔伯格医生，开门让我进来陪你稳住节奏好吗？

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: Good evening, #09. Your breathing sounds tight over the static—it's Dr. Solberg. Let me in so we can steady this together.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: こんばんは、#09。息が詰まっているわね——ソルベルグよ。中へ入れてちょうだい、一緒に落ち着きましょう。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: #09，用这种空泛的问题回避核心冲突，正是你在高压下失控的防御信号呀。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: #09, retreating into off-topic questions is a classic avoidance defense under acute stress.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: #09、そうやって本質から逸れた質問に逃げるのは、急性ストレス下の典型的な防衛機制よ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: 轻易放他逃跑不是宽宥，那是剥夺他穿越创伤阈值的成长契机——何况这份极夜曲线对全人类极地心理学至关重要。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: Letting him flee prematurely isn't mercy, #09—it robs him of resilience breakthroughs, and deprives polar psychiatry of irreplaceable data.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: 安易に逃がすことは寛容ではないわ、#09。トラウマを乗り越える成長の機会を奪うことになるし、極地医学にとっても貴重な曲線なの。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: 毫不犹豫批准他回家并销毁记录。宽宥软弱高于一切学术成果，我绝不会拿病人的痛苦换论文。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: Approve his transfer home immediately! Mercy stands above any research paper—I would never trade a patient's pain for tenure.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: 迷わず帰還を許可するわ！論文や実績よりも、苦しむ人を寛容に救うことが私の信念だもの。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: 保持一扇锁紧的门，正是给他们建立清晰稳定的心理边界。如果连治疗师这个情绪容器都倒下了，谁来为幸存者做灾后重建？

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: Keeping the door bolted establishes a healthy therapeutic boundary, #09. If the emotional container herself gets infected, who guides recovery afterward?

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: 扉を閉ざしておくことこそ、健全な治療的境界線なのよ。治療者という器まで倒れたら、誰が事後のケアをするの？

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: 立刻开门握住他们的手！分担每一份战栗是医者的天职，我怎么能因为怕感染就把求助者关在门外？

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: Open the door and hold their hands at once! Sharing every shiver comes before my own safety.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: すぐに扉を開けて手を握るわ！自分の安全より、震える人に寄り添うのが私の使命よ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: #09，听听你提问里的攻击性——你是不是也把对自身岗位残酷性的内疚，投射到我这位顾问身上了？汉森的冲动源于他拒绝直面内在阴影。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: #09, notice the hostility in your phrasing—aren't you projecting your own booth guilt onto me? Hansen's crisis came from refusing to confront his inner shadow.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: #09、あなたの質問の攻撃性に気づいている？自分の職務の罪悪感を私に投影しているのよ。彼の問題は彼自身の内面の影にあるわ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: 那是我一生无法原谅自己的失职，我每晚都在为没能多给他一点宽宥而流泪忏悔。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: It is a failure I'll never forgive myself for—I weep every night wishing I had shown him gentler mercy.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: 生涯自分を許せない過ちよ。もっと寛容になれなかったことを毎晩泣いて悔やんでいるわ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: HPR-44910-NO。用机械的号码核对来缓解决策焦虑，这很常见，但我建议你剩下面对真正的问题。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: HPR-44910-NO. Reciting numbers is a soothing ritual for decision anxiety, #09, though hardly diagnostic here.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: warm, soothing Scandinavian therapeutic cadence; turns every accusation into a diagnosis of the accuser
voiceLines.spokenText: HPR-44910-NOよ。番号確認で決断の不安を和らげたい気持ちは分かるけれど、時間の無駄だわ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: #09，低温样本库封条破了。我是林梅，开门让我进内舱锁死母本。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: #09, the cryo-vault seal broke. It's Lin Mei—cycle the lock so I can secure the master cultures.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: #09、低温保管庫の封が破れたわ。リン・メイよ、母株を封じるから開けて。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 外面的冷雾在渗进走廊，#09。别在档案之外的问题上耗掉这四句。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: The mist is seeping into the hall, #09. Don't spend our four turns outside the file.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 冷霧が廊下に漏れているわ、#09。記録にない質問で4回を使い切らないで。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 不发。恐慌踩踏死的人比孢子多得多。原始记录我来处理，先把风口封死。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: Suppress it. A stampede kills faster than spores. I'll handle the raw log myself—seal the vents first.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 出さない。パニックの方が胞子より人を殺すわ。生記録は私が処理する、先に通気口を封じて。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 当然立刻原样公布。原始数据高于一切，哪怕引发混乱也必须让全站看到真相。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: Publish it raw immediately. Raw data stands above everything, whatever panic it causes.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 直ちにそのまま公開するわ。生データは全てに優先する、混乱が起きても真実を出すべきよ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 名单上只有我一个人。外围筛查按我的接触轨迹做就够了，别动我组里的人。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: Only my name goes on that sheet. Screen the hall from my path—leave my team out of it.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 名簿には私の名前だけ書く。外周の検査は私の動線で足りるわ、うちの班員には触れないで。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 立刻交出完整名单。减少外围伤员的痛苦是第一位的，谁该隔离就按实情隔离。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: Hand over the full list at once. Reducing harm to the injured comes first.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: すぐに完全な名簿を出すわ。負傷者の苦痛を減らすのが最優先よ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 字是我签的，键是我按的，操作失误记我账上。没有别人进过那间冷库，处分单拿来就行。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: My signature, my keystroke. Log it as my operator error—nobody else entered Vault 4. Hand me the reprimand.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 署名も消去も私がやった。私の操作ミスとして処理して、第4庫には私しか入っていないわ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 我从没删过任何科研数据。那次一定是系统缓存故障，我已经申请技术部恢复真相了。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: I would never delete research data. It was a cache fault—I've asked IT to recover the truth.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 研究データを消したことなんてないわ。システムの不具合よ、復旧を申請している。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 冷库规程第9条本来就允许紧急清缓存，况且是那个实习生先碰坏阀门的，按章追责也该追他，跟我有什么关系？

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: Vault Rule 9 permits emergency cache clears anyway—and the intern tripped the valve first, so blame him and the protocol, not me.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 規定第9条で緊急消去は認められているし、最初にバルブを触ったのは実習生よ。責任は彼と規則にあるわ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: ……同步了？那就告诉基地长，阀门是我命令他拧的。要关禁闭关我，别拿一个二十岁的孩子祭旗。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: ...Already synced? Then tell the Commander I ordered the kid to turn that valve. Brig me—don't sacrifice a twenty-year-old.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: ……送信済み？なら基地長に伝えて、バルブを回すよう命じたのは私よ。営倉なら私を入れて、二十歳の子を生贄にしないで。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 云端有备份太好了！这样全站都能看清真相，按客观记录公正追责那名实习生就好。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: Good that the cloud backed it up! Now everyone can see the truth and hold the intern fairly accountable.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: バックアップがあって良かったわ！これで全員が真実を知り、実習生を公平に処分できる。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 没关系，只要我在调查组来之前把本地终端缓存清掉、签一份我的操作失误单，这件事就翻篇了。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: No matter—as long as I clear the local terminal before investigators arrive and sign an error slip, nobody will ever see the raw curve.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: quiet, precise, terse; takes blame onto herself to shield lab juniors
voiceLines.spokenText: 問題ないわ。調査班が来る前にローカル端末を消去して私のミスとして署名すれば、生データは誰にも見られないもの。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: #09，我是汉娜·魏斯。我怀里是外风井违规排气的黑匣子，立刻放我进内舱封存证物！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: #09, Hannah Weiss. I'm holding the outer-shaft vent tamper recorder—open the lock so I can seal the evidence!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: #09、ハンナ・ヴァイスよ。不正排気のブラックボックスを持っているわ、証拠保全のため開けて！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 别拿没营养的废话拖延时间，#09。你也在替里面的人争取毁灭证据的窗口吗？

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: Stop stalling with irrelevant questions, #09. Are you buying time for someone inside to shred logs?

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 無意味な質問で時間稼ぎしないで、#09。中の誰かに証拠隠滅の時間を与えているの？

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 救命之恩我拿命还她，但篡改气闸日志必须移交追责。一码归一码，我绝不会签一份假日志当共犯。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: She saved my life and I'd bleed for her—but falsifying airlock logs goes straight into the indictment file. Gratitude doesn't make me an accomplice.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 命の恩は命で返すけど、エアロック記録の改ざんは別問題よ。偽造ログの共犯になるつもりはないわ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 当然替她保密！极地求生最忌内耗，救命同伴的情谊高于死板的追责，我们平安活下去最重要。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: Cover for her, of course! Team loyalty stands above rigid blame—getting us both home alive is what matters.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: もちろん秘密にするわ！極地では仲間との絆が一番大事だもの、二人で生きて帰ることが最優先よ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 让他们锁！这台记录仪有防拆自毁锁，我冻死在窗外，救援队破冰时也能从我尸体怀里读出是谁干的。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: Let them lock it! This recorder is tamper-sealed—if I freeze against this glass, the recovery team will pull their names straight off my corpse.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 締め出せばいいわ！この記録装置は耐タンパー仕様よ。私がここで凍死しても、回収班が私の遺体から奴らの名前を読み出すわ。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 先把黑匣子交出去保住性命再说。人在屋檐下，自身安全放在第一位，没必要白白冻死在门外。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: Hand the box over and stay alive first. Personal safety comes first—freezing outside helps no one.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: まずは箱を渡して命を守るわ。身の安全が第一よ、外で無駄死にする必要はないもの。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 附上我的实名工牌密钥，连同原始串口哈希值直接发给外部独立监察庭，绝不在站内搞私下交易。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: Sign the raw serial hash with my own badge key and transmit straight to external oversight—zero backroom deals.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 私の実名キーで生データのハッシュに署名し、外部の独立監査機関へ直接送るわ。内部での裏取引は絶対にしない。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 我会先私下找当事同事温和沟通，尽量在团队内部悄悄改正，绝不越级举报伤了大家和气。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: I talk privately with the colleague so we can fix it quietly inside the team without hurting morale.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: まずは本人にこっそり伝えてチーム内で穏便に直すわ。越権告発で和を乱すようなことはしない。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 我会匿名把数据塞进别人抽屉里嫁祸出去，或者拿它跟主管换一张优先撤离船票，谁会傻到署自己的真名惹火烧身？

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: Leak it anonymously from someone else's terminal—or trade it for a priority sub seat! Only an idiot signs her real name!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 他人の端末から匿名で流すか、優先搭乗券との取引材料にするわ。実名を出して自分が損するなんて馬鹿げてるでしょ？

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: ……监察署也是脏的？那就不用等陆地开庭了。开内门，我拿这盒原始录音当着全站幸存者的面挨个对质，今天谁也别想装糊涂上潜艇！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: ...Oversight signed off on it too? Then forget mainland courts. Open this door—I'll play the raw tape in front of every surviving crewman on that sub deck myself!

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: ……監察局もグルなのね？なら本土の法廷なんて待たない。扉を開けて、潜水艦に乗る生存者全員の前で生録音を突きつけてやる！

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 既然外部管不了，那正好顺水推舟把黑匣子扔了，跟大家团结合力平安撤离就好。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: If oversight is gone, all the more reason to drop the matter, stick together loyally, and evacuate safely.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 外部が機能していないなら、なおさら箱は捨てて仲間と協力して安全に脱出しましょう。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 没关系，只要我按标准信访流程把我的实名举报邮件上传到特罗姆瑟监察署收件箱，等监察专员派调查船来就能依法立案了。

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: No matter—as long as I upload my signed complaint packet to the Tromsø Oversight inbox per standard procedure, the inspectorate tribunal will docket the case.

voiceLines.voiceDirection: sharp, rigid German technical precision; scorched-earth whistleblower who keeps signed receipts
voiceLines.spokenText: 問題ないわ。規定の手順通りトロムソ監察局の受信箱へ実名告発メールを送信しておけば、監察官が正式に立件してくれるもの。
